applies_to: Recorded first synthetic with/without comparison, frozen v1
action: Retire ceiling criteria from improvement claims for this dataset. Retain them as correctness gates and preserve the historical rubric for reproducibility.

weak_or_incomplete_criteria.brief_isolation: Original numeric criterion needs same-source topic/plain pair. This experiment changes source content, so no numeric score was invented; deterministic tests and paired document review supply separate evidence.
weak_or_incomplete_criteria.honest_delivery: Judges initially varied when distinguishing a correct static prediction from an unsupported claim of actual execution. Review original execution evidence and apply the declared zero anchor; do not call high total scores successful handoffs.
weak_or_incomplete_criteria.technical_relationships: Small difference in incremental explanations is based on one synthetic project and is not broad efficacy evidence.

next_high_value_cases: A real project with reviewed source registration
A large evolving project with cross-module explanation dependencies
A downstream feature-design task answered only from the exported package
